GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (13 Nov 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 277)
APO 500
13 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Production of Radio Receivers.
1. The Japanese government will submit a plan by 1 December 1945 for the manufacture and distribution during the year January through December 1946 of home radio receivers of all types, repair parts and tubes. The plan will contemplate approaching a level where an average of 50% of the Japanese homes would be radio equipped.
2. The plan will include but is not limited to the following information:
a. The number of complete radio sets that will be manufactured, by months, for the year 1946.
b. A list of manufactures who will produce the radio sets, parts and tubes, showing monthly production by each.
c. The quantity and type of raw materials which will be allocated by the Japanese government to accomplish the plan formulated.
d. The methods, channels and organizations planned for accomplishing the distribution of the finished products.
e. A comparison of the pre-war prices and the proposed prices to the buying public for the various types of complete radio sets and tubes.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
